incoming.name: Cambrian explosion
incoming.excerpt: Over the last decades, a rich and diverse prokaryotic and eukaryotic biota has been documented from Proterozoic rocks around the world.

incoming.name: Fossil
incoming.section: Developments in interpretation of the fossil record
incoming.excerpt: The Ediacaran biota (also called Vendian biota) dating from 575 million years ago collectively constitutes a richly diverse assembly of early multicellular eukaryotes.
